decision.during_CARA_collection: Do not schedule the new GMSD T5 load or label job on this shared host; retain the current wait. No modification or suspension of CARA.
decision.reason: Reported free memory is below the existing GMSD 40 GiB gate; CPU, memory-bandwidth and I/O competition can affect the full-request clocks even on another GPU. No registered inter-path or warmup window can safely contain an asynchronously loaded T5 job.
decision.after_CARA_GPU_release: Only a fresh admission review becomes possible. This record is not an unconditional start authorization and does not change GMSD policy.
required_observations_before_reconsidera: Original CARA GPU child exited; billing and local ledger settled; original GPU lock released; no inference request will resume
Fresh MemAvailable passes the unchanged GMSD 40 GiB gate while preserving CARA post-score 8 GiB envelope and host headroom
Read actual CARA post-child CPU affinity; any GMSD CPU placement must not overlap those CPUs; keep existing CPU/memory/I/O limits and verify shared-host resource feasibility
If only snapshots or core affinity exist without a reliable bound on shared memory/IO impact, wait for CARA CPU scoring to finish
